trigger_condition.state_trigger: Tensor is a torch.Tensor subclass instance created with as_subclass
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: torch.max is called with a dim argument
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input must be a torch.Tensor subclass instance created via as_subclass; call torch.max(input, dim=...) to trigger the namedtuple return path.

bug_oracle.description: torch.max returns a plain tuple rather than a namedtuple when applied to a Tensor subclass, violating the documented return type.
bug_oracle.signal: Return value has type tuple rather than torch.return_types.max and lacks values/indices attributes.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Wrap tensors with different Tensor subclass types using as_subclass or lightweight subclass constructors.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create base tensors with varied shapes, dtypes, and devices, then convert them to Tensor subclass instances.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Provide dim argument to torch.max to exercise the reduction/namedtuple return path.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: For each subclass tensor, call torch.max(x, dim=selected_dim) and inspect the returned object type and attributes.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Check that the result is an instance of torch.return_types.max and has values and indices attributes; report plain tuple or missing named fields as incorrect output.
